It ships every item the workbook row and skill quality-checks.md:97 name: judge CLI @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281 (Dockerfile:17), matching REWARDKIT_JUDGE=claude-code in task.toml:31; Playwright MCP @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (Dockerfile:19), which provides the playwright-mcp command used by every judge.toml; Chromium installed by that pinned package's own bundled Playwright CLI into /opt/playwright-browsers and linked to /usr/local/bin/chromium (Dockerfile:33-38), the exact --executable-path in gates/render/judge.toml:12, so the browser build is fixed by the pinned Playwright version; harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (Dockerfile:31) with its patch asserting the expected source line (Dockerfile:41); python3 from the python:3.12-slim base at /usr/local/bin/python3, the path scored/functional/judge.toml:17 uses for restart_mcp.py; Node 22 copied from node:22-bookworm-slim (Dockerfile:1,4); util-linux (setpriv, setsid) and procps for the unprivileged launch in test.sh:104-111 (Dockerfile:13); fonts for rendering. App runtime: solution/app/server.js:2-5 requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3; the verifier image installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally (Dockerfile:20-21) with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (Dockerfile:9, test.sh:106), the same versions as environment/Dockerfile:10-11 and as promised to the builder in integration.md:5; the other package.json dependencies (prettier, acorn, react) are bundled into public/assets and not required by the server. Broken-app probe: an app that depends on a module outside express/better-sqlite3 without vendoring it in /app/node_modules would fail to start in both images alike, and integration.md:5 tells the builder to include everything needed at runtime, so that is a correct zero, not an image defect. Conforming-alternative probe: an app vendoring its own /app/node_modules still launches (artifact /app is copied; node resolves local modules first); a native module compiled in the agent image runs because both images use the same Node 22 /usr/local tree. Measured: raw-evidence-index hashes all verified. The scripted golden run on these exact bytes launched the installed app with the same uid 65534 / env -i / NODE_PATH / DB_PATH command line as test.sh and drove it with Chromium from a verifier image (run_golden.sh), but in the agent image and not through tests/test.sh. The hosted Oracle run on an EARLIER candidate (reward.json reward 0.9833, graded 1) shows the configured judge launching and grading with this template verifier. Disclosed gap, not waived: no full tests/test.sh configured-judge launch exists for these exact bytes; that is the separate hash-bound verifier-launch runtime record REVIEW_POLICY.md requires before local clearance, and this Pass does not substitute for it. The changes since the hosted run (criteria/prompt text, golden CSS/markup) do not touch the image recipe or the server's dependencies.
